conventions.units: W = GG.W, H = GG.H (canvas 720x1280 in phaser-kit; 2x the 360x640 logical grid). Speeds in H/s or W/s, sizes as fractions of W, times in seconds. Multiply every speed by GG.speed (audience profile). Min tap target in canvas px = profile.minTapTargetPx * GG.W / 360.
conventions.tags: [S:key] = number or rule taken from the source with that key in genre-recipes-sources.md; [H] = our own estimate (heuristic), tune with play data.
conventions.difficultyCurve: d(t) = 1 + sqrt(t / 167), t = seconds since round start: 1.42 at 30 s, 1.6 at 60 s, 2.04 at 180 s. Multiply spawn rate and speeds by d(t), divide spawn intervals by d(t) [S:cho]. Add a sawtooth: after each wave/banner, the next wave starts about 20% easier than the previous peak, then climbs again [S:missile].
universal: Visible + audible reaction to every input within 100 ms (Swink: 50 ms feels instant, >100 ms noticeable, 200 ms sluggish) [S:swink]

Juice level medium-to-high, never none and never extreme: both extremes lowered play time and enjoyment (N=3018) [S:kao]. Juice does not improve player performance, so gameplay must be readable without it [S:hicks]
Hitstop 20-60 ms on hits and kills only (GG.fx.hit already pauses physics 60 ms); Nijman ~20 ms, Celeste 50 ms on dash [S:nijman][S:celeste]

Screen shake only for damage, explosions and big combos, never continuous; it caused nausea in Nuclear Throne playtests. Use GG.fx.shake('light'|'medium'|'heavy'); calm audiences get half amplitude automatically [S:nijman][S:eiserloh]
Flashes: at most 3 per second (WCAG 2.3.1); GG.fx.flash is limited to one per 3 s
Haptics optional and short: GG.vibrate(15) for a tap (Android keyclick 10-20 ms), at most 3 strengths, gaps >= 50 ms; iOS Safari has no navigator.vibrate, so it is never the only feedback [S:haptics]
Player hitbox smaller than its sprite (Canabalt: 12x14 inside 24x24, about 50-60%), pickups larger than they look, hazards smaller than they look [S:canabalt][S:igarashi][S:fruitninja]
Every hazard is telegraphed before it can hurt: spawn above or outside the screen, or show a warning for at least 0.5 s [H][S:stout]
Random spawns from a shuffled bag (Tetris 7-bag) instead of pure Math.random, so there are no long droughts or streaks [S:tetris]
Never spawn a hazard on or right next to the player; always leave a reachable path [S:spelunky]
Phaser Arcade has no continuous collision: keep each body's move per frame under half the smallest obstacle size, or the body tunnels through [S:phaser]
Onboarding: the player learns by doing; at most 8 words on screen at once; first 5-10 s with no way to fail [S:pvz][H]
Some failure helps: players who lost some lives but still finished rated the game highest (Juul, n=85) [S:juul]
llmPitfallsAll: State not reset on restart: the runtime calls scene.restart() during self-check and on every replay; initialise all fields in create()/init(), clear arrays and timers, never at top level [S:phaser][S:opengame]
Game never ends or freezes: no reachable GG.win/GG.lose, timers that stop, a win condition counted on objects that never spawn [S:opengame]
Mode collapse: the model writes the familiar version (classic Pong, Flappy) instead of the requested twist; keep the user's mustHave mechanic [S:factorsim]

Collision logic wrong or in the wrong order: reset/respawn runs before the collision check, overlap used where collider is needed, sprite and body sizes differ (use setSize/setCircle) [S:factorsim][S:phaser]
Puzzle and UI games fail rules silently (match detection, pair checks): they scored lowest on intent alignment (52.6 vs 76.8 for platformers) [S:opengame]
Frame-rate dependent movement: use delta (seconds = delta/1000) or Arcade velocities, never a fixed px-per-update [S:phaser]
Pooled objects keep physics bodies alive: disableBody(true, true) when recycling, enableBody on reuse [S:phaser]
Empty or static screen in the first seconds: something must move or invite a tap from frame one [H][S:opengame]

genres.coreLoop: Items fall from the top; move the basket to catch good ones and dodge bad ones.
genres.controls: Drag anywhere: basket follows the finger's x (relative drag, not teleport). Alternative for seniors/kids: tap left or right half to step one lane of 5.
progression: Spawn interval 0.9 s / d(t) (about 0.44 s at 180 s) [S:cho][H]
Fall speed 0.28 H/s * d(t); at start an item takes about 3.5 s to fall, well above human reaction delay 0.29 s [S:flappy][H]
Bad items: none for the first 10 s, then about 1 in 6 (Fruit Ninja bomb ratio), up to 1 in 4 after 60 s [S:fruitninja][H]
Wave = 20 s; banner 'Уровень N' on each wave; next wave starts 20% slower than the previous peak (sawtooth) [S:missile][H]
Max 4 items on screen at once for kids and seniors, 7 for others [H]
objectKinds: good item: +1 point, catch zone 1.2x its sprite [S:igarashi]
rare golden item (1 in 15): +5 points, falls 20% faster [H]
bad item: lose a life or -3 points, hitbox 70% of sprite [S:fruitninja]
powerUps: Magnet: good items within 0.25 W fly into the basket, 7 s [S:fruitninja][H]
Wide basket: basket width x1.6, 8 s [S:arkanoid]
Slow time: fall speed x0.5, 6 s [S:arkanoid]
juice: Catch: GG.fx.squash(basket) + GG.fx.float(x, y, '+1') + GG.sfx('coin')
Combo of 5 catches without a miss: GG.fx.burst at basket in accent color + rising pitch of the coin sound
Items pop in with GG.fx.pop and rotate slowly while falling
Missed good item: grey splat stays on the ground for 2 s (permanence) [S:nijman]
Bad item caught: GG.fx.shake('medium') + red tint flash on basket 150 ms + GG.sfx('hit')
Basket leans in the direction of movement (angle = velocity x 0.02, clamp 12 degrees) [S:juicy-breakout][H]
Wave change: GG.fx.banner('Уровень 2!')
Short GG.vibrate(15) on catch for adults/teens
failStates: 3 lives lost (misses of good items or bad items caught)
timer ends below target
genres.winCondition: Catch the target number (e.g. 30 in 60 s) or survive the round timer.

audienceTweaks.kids: No bad items, or only very distinct ones (a grey stone vs bright fruit); misses do not cost lives; spawn interval at least 1.2 s.
audienceTweaks.teens: Bad items from second 5, golden items worth chasing, best-score combo counter on screen.
audienceTweaks.seniors: Fall speed x0.6, max 3 items on screen, lane-tap control, no time pressure on the final score, 5 lives.

commonPitfalls: Basket teleports to the touch point instead of following a relative drag (finger hides the basket) [H]
Two items spawn in one column at once so one is uncatchable [H]
Items spawn below the HUD band or already overlapping the basket [S:spelunky]
Speed grows without a cap until the game is impossible at 60 s [S:cho]

genres.coreLoop: The hero bounces automatically on platforms; steer left/right to climb as high as possible.
genres.controls: Hold left or right half of the screen to move, or drag horizontally. Bounce is automatic. The screen wraps horizontally.
progression: Jump parametrised by apex height and time: h = 0.25 H, t_apex = 0.42 s, so v0 = 2h/t = 1.19 H/s and gravity = 2h/t^2 = 2.83 H/s^2 [S:pittman][H]
Vertical gap between platforms 0.09 H at start, growing with height, capped at 0.17 H (about 2/3 of the jump height) so every gap stays reachable [S:canabalt][H]
Moving platforms appear after 15% of the target height, speed 0.25 W/s rising to 0.5 W/s; breaking platforms after 35% [S:doodle][H]
Balance rule: each new obstacle type arrives together with a new power-up (Lima Sky) [S:doodle]
Horizontal speed 1.1 W/s; air time 0.84 s gives about 0.9 W of reach [H]
objectKinds: breaking platform: crumbles on touch, no bounce
enemy or hole (from 50% height): touch = fall, telegraphed by a wobble
powerUps: Spring on a platform: bounce x2 height (Doodle Jump spring ~352 points of height) [S:doodle]
Propeller / jetpack: fly up 2.5 s with no collisions, then a normal fall [S:doodle][H]
Shield bubble: survives one enemy touch [H]
juice: Landing: GG.fx.squash(hero) and a small dust burst (GG.fx.burst, count 6) under the feet
Hero stretches vertically while rising, squashes at the bottom of the fall (scaleY 1.15/0.85) [S:juicy-breakout]
Breaking platform splits into two halves that fall and rotate
Camera follows upwards with lerp k = 0.1 per frame, never down [S:eiserloh]
Height milestone every 1000 points: GG.fx.banner + GG.sfx('levelup')
Spring: GG.sfx('jump') with higher pitch, platform spring compresses then pops
Falling off the bottom: hero spins and shrinks, GG.fx.shake('light')
failStates: Fall below the bottom of the screen
touch an enemy without a shield
genres.winCondition: Reach a target height (e.g. 3000) within the round, or best height when the timer ends.

audienceTweaks.kids: No enemies, wide platforms (0.3 W), gap capped at 0.12 H; falling once respawns on the lowest visible platform instead of game over.
audienceTweaks.teens: Enemies from 30% height, moving platforms faster, leaderboard-style best height marker line.
audienceTweaks.seniors: Tap-and-hold halves only (no drag), gravity x0.7, gaps capped at 0.1 H, no breaking platforms.

commonPitfalls: Platforms collide from below and block the jump; they must be one-way (collide only while falling: body.velocity.y > 0) [H]
Generated gaps larger than the jump height, so the run becomes impossible [S:canabalt]
Camera scrolls down too, or platforms are never recycled and memory grows [S:phaser]
Bounce triggered every frame while overlapping, launching the hero into space [S:factorsim]

genres.coreLoop: Ship at the bottom fires automatically; drag to dodge and aim at waves descending from above.
genres.controls: Drag anywhere: ship moves by the finger delta (relative), stays in the bottom 40%. Fire is automatic.
progression: Player fire every 0.14 s, bullet speed 1.6 H/s, bullets big and bright (Nijman: bigger bullets, high fire rate) [S:nijman][H]
Wave n has 5 + 2n enemies; wave ends when cleared or after 15 s [H]
Enemy fire interval 2.5 s per enemy, falling to 1.2 s; Space Invaders shortens fire delay as score rises (48 to 7 frames) [S:invaders][H]
Formation speeds up as fewer enemies remain (Space Invaders moves one invader per frame) [S:invaders]
Enemy bullets at most 0.45 H/s and at least 0.02 W in radius, with contrasting color [H]
Every 4th wave is a big wave; the next wave drops back about 20% (sawtooth like Missile Command 12, 15, 18, 12...) [S:missile]
objectKinds: grunt: 1 hit, flies in a formation
diver: dives toward the player's x after a 0.5 s glow telegraph
tank: 5 hits, flashes white on each hit
powerUps: Triple shot: 3-way spread, 8 s (Nijman's 'triple machine gun') [S:nijman][H]
Shield: absorbs 1 hit, visible bubble [H]
Bomb: clears all enemy bullets and damages everything on screen, single use [S:missile]
juice: Muzzle flash: first frame of each bullet is a bright circle [S:nijman]
Enemy hit: white flash 1 frame + knockback a few px up [S:nijman]
Enemy kill: GG.fx.hit(enemy) (60 ms hitstop + burst) + GG.sfx('explode'); about a third leave a bigger explosion [S:nijman]
Wreck debris stays on screen 1.5 s (permanence) [S:nijman]
Player hit: GG.fx.shake('heavy') + ship blinks 1.5 s of invulnerability
Camera kicks 2-4 px opposite to the firing direction on each volley [S:nijman][H]
Score popups GG.fx.float on kills, bigger for tanks
Wave cleared: GG.fx.banner('Волна 3') + GG.sfx('levelup')
failStates: Lives (3) lost to bullets or collisions
an enemy reaches the bottom line
genres.winCondition: Clear the final wave (e.g. wave 6) or survive the round timer; boss optional.

audienceTweaks.kids: Enemies never shoot, they only drift down slowly; hits shrink rather than kill the ship; cartoon 'pop' instead of explosions.
audienceTweaks.teens: Faster waves (start at wave 2), more divers, combo multiplier for kills within 1 s.
audienceTweaks.seniors: Enemy bullets x0.5 speed and big, 5 lives, invulnerability 2.5 s after a hit, no divers.

commonPitfalls: Player hitbox equals the sprite, so near misses feel unfair; use about 40-50% [S:canabalt]
Bullets never destroyed off-screen (leak and slowdown); recycle through a group pool [S:phaser]
Fast bullets tunnel through small enemies; keep speed per frame under half the enemy size [S:phaser]
Finger hides the ship: ship should sit above the touch point or move by relative delta [H]

genres.coreLoop: Targets pop up and move for a short time; tap them before they hide, avoid the forbidden ones.
genres.controls: Tap a target. No aiming drag needed. Tap target size follows the audience profile.
progression: Round of 10 targets; pass needs 6 hits, later rounds 7, 8, 9 (Duck Hunt: 6/10 in rounds 1-10, then 7, 8, 9, 10) [S:duckhunt]
Target lifetime 2.2 s, x0.85 each round, floor 0.8 s [H]
At most 3 targets visible at once; next one appears 0.4-0.9 s after the previous [H]
Points rise with round number (Duck Hunt 500 to 800 to 1000 per duck) [S:duckhunt]
Forbidden targets (e.g. a friend, a bomb) from round 2, about 1 in 6 [S:fruitninja][H]
objectKinds: fast flyer: crosses the screen in 1.5 s, double points
armoured target: 2 taps, cracks after the first
forbidden target: tapping it costs a life
powerUps: Freeze: all targets stop and the round timer pauses, 7 s (Fruit Ninja Freeze ~7 s) [S:fruitninja]
Double points: 7 s [S:fruitninja]
Frenzy: targets spawn 3x faster, 7 s [S:fruitninja]
juice: Hit: GG.fx.hit(target) (hitstop + spin-off) + GG.sfx('pop')
Missed tap: small dust puff at the tap point and a dull click
Targets pop up with GG.fx.pop and wobble before hiding (0.3 s warning)
Streak of 3 hits: floating 'x2' combo text, rising pitch
Bullet holes stay on the background (permanence) [S:nijman]
Forbidden target hit: GG.fx.shake('medium') + red vignette 200 ms
Round summary: hits counted one by one with GG.sfx('coin')
failStates: Fewer hits than required in a round
3 forbidden targets hit
genres.winCondition: Pass all rounds (e.g. 4 rounds x 10 targets in about 80 s).

audienceTweaks.kids: Lifetime at least 2.5 s, no forbidden targets, every tap near a target counts (hit zone 1.5x).
audienceTweaks.teens: Fast flyers from round 1, accuracy bonus, floor 0.6 s.
audienceTweaks.seniors: Only 1-2 targets at once, lifetime at least 3 s, targets never move while visible, pass mark 5/10.

commonPitfalls: Targets smaller than the profile's minimum tap target [H]
Hit test on the sprite's transparent box corners or only on its exact pixels (pixelPerfect is expensive); use a circle hitArea at least the tap target size [S:phaser]
Targets overlap the HUD or each other, so one tap counts twice [H]
Using 'click' events instead of pointerdown on mobile [S:phaser]

genres.coreLoop: The hero runs forward automatically in one of 3 lanes; switch lanes and jump to dodge obstacles and grab coins.
genres.controls: Swipe left/right to change lane, swipe up to jump. Tap-alternative: tap left/right third to change lane, tap middle to jump.
progression: 3 lanes (genre convention, no primary source) [H]
World speed 0.55 H/s * d(t), capped at 1.1 H/s [S:cho][H]
Distance between obstacle rows at least speed x 0.9 s (reaction 0.29 s + lane change 0.15 s, doubled for safety) [S:flappy][H]
Each obstacle row blocks at most 2 of 3 lanes, and the free lane must be reachable from the previous free lane [S:spelunky]
Coin trails every 2-3 rows guide the safe line [H]
Special set-piece every 20 s (Canabalt: special events every 3-8 buildings) [S:canabalt][H]
powerUps: Magnet: pulls coins from all lanes, 8 s [H]
Shield: survive one crash [H]
Double coins: 7 s [S:fruitninja]
juice: Lane change: hero tilts 10 degrees and stretches sideways 80 ms
Jump: GG.fx.squash on take-off and landing + dust burst
Coin: GG.sfx('coin'), pitch rises for every coin in a trail
Speed lines on the sides when speed passes 0.8 H/s
Near miss (obstacle passes within 0.05 W): small '+5 близко!' float [H]
Crash: GG.fx.shake('heavy') + hero tumbles + 300 ms slow-motion (Nijman drops to 10 fps at the climax) [S:nijman]
Milestone every 500 m: GG.fx.banner
failStates: Crash into an obstacle without a shield
genres.winCondition: Reach the target distance (e.g. 2000 m) or the timer ends with the most coins.

audienceTweaks.kids: Speed x0.7, no jump obstacles (lane change only), crash costs coins instead of ending the run.
audienceTweaks.teens: Faster cap (1.3 H/s), near-miss bonus, combo coins.
audienceTweaks.seniors: Tap thirds instead of swipes, speed capped at 0.6 H/s, rows at least speed x 1.5 s apart, 3 lives.

commonPitfalls: All 3 lanes blocked in one row: an impossible pattern [S:spelunky]
Lane switch instant teleport with no animation, so the player cannot see what happened [H]
Swipe recognised as a tap (or vice versa); use a minimum distance of about 0.06 W for swipes [H]
Obstacles spawned visible at the top already inside the danger zone [S:stout]

genres.coreLoop: Bounce the ball off the paddle to break all bricks; don't let it fall.
genres.controls: Drag horizontally anywhere: paddle follows the finger's x (relative). Tap to launch the ball.
progression: Ball speeds up after 4 hits, after 12 hits, and on first contact with the two top rows (Atari Breakout rules); each step +12% [S:breakout][H]
Base ball speed 0.55 H/s, cap 1.0 H/s; at 60 fps that is 21 px per frame at H = 1280, so bricks must be at least 44 px tall to avoid tunneling [S:phaser][H]
7 columns x 5-6 rows of bricks in portrait (original had 14 per row on landscape) [S:breakout][H]
Top rows worth more (Breakout: 1/3/5/7 points by row pair) [S:breakout]
Bounce angle depends on where the ball hits the paddle: centre straight up, edges up to 60 degrees [H]
Capsule drops after a random 4-8 broken bricks, only one capsule at a time (Arkanoid) [S:arkanoid][H]
objectKinds: silver brick: 2 hits, cracks after first [S:arkanoid]
capsule: falls slowly, catch with the paddle
powerUps: Expand: paddle x1.6 until the next capsule or ball loss [S:arkanoid]
Multi-ball (Disruption): ball splits into 3; no capsules while more than one ball is in play [S:arkanoid]
Slow: ball speed back to base; it speeds up again with hits [S:arkanoid]
juice: Bricks fly in at start: from y -500, random rotation +-45 degrees, scale 0.2, 0.7 s with bounce easing, random delay [S:juicy-breakout]
Paddle stretch: scaleX = 1 + |dx|/100, scaleY = 1.5 - scaleX*0.5 while moving [S:juicy-breakout]
Ball stretches along velocity (scaleX up to +0.3, scaleY down to -0.2) and flashes white on each hit [S:juicy-breakout]
Brick hit: jelly scale to 1.2 in 0.05 s, back with elastic in 0.6 s; destroyed bricks fall with gravity, spin and darken [S:juicy-breakout]
Particles: 5 on wall/brick hits, 20 confetti on paddle hits [S:juicy-breakout]
Ball trail of about 30 segments [S:juicy-breakout]
Small spring shake on brick hits, GG.fx.shake('heavy') on ball loss [S:juicy-breakout]
Separate sounds for wall, brick and paddle; brick pitch rises in a combo [S:juicy-breakout]
failStates: All balls lost (3 balls, like the original) [S:breakout]
genres.winCondition: Break all breakable bricks within the round.

audienceTweaks.kids: Ball speed x0.7 with no speed-ups, paddle 1.5x wider, a bouncy floor saves the ball 3 times.
audienceTweaks.teens: All speed-ups, silver bricks, paddle shrinks to half after the ball first hits the top wall (Breakout rule) [S:breakout].
audienceTweaks.seniors: Ball speed cap 0.6 H/s, paddle 0.4 W wide, ball launches only on tap, 5 balls.

commonPitfalls: Ball stuck in a perfectly horizontal or vertical loop; enforce a minimum vertical speed and nudge the angle [H]
Ball tunnels through bricks or the paddle at high speed [S:phaser]
Ball gets pushed into the paddle and jitters; reflect only when moving downward [S:factorsim]
Win check counts gold (indestructible) bricks, so the level can never end [S:opengame]

genres.coreLoop: A block slides back and forth above the tower; tap to drop it. The overhang is cut off, so the tower narrows unless you are precise.
progression: Block slides at 0.55 W/s, +4% per floor, cap 1.5 W/s [H]
Perfect drop if offset <= 4% of block width: block snaps exactly, no cut [H]
After 8 perfect drops in a row the block grows back by 10% (reported, not verified for Ketchapp's Stack) [S:stack][H]
Camera rises one floor per drop; every 10 floors the background hue shifts [H]
Slide direction alternates between left and right entries [H]
powerUps: Wide block: next 3 blocks spawn 1.3x wider [H]
Slow slide: speed x0.5 for 3 blocks [H]
juice: Drop: GG.fx.squash(tower top) + GG.sfx('tap') with pitch rising per floor
Cut piece falls with gravity and spins, then fades [S:juicy-breakout]
Perfect drop: white outline ring expanding from the block + GG.fx.float('Идеально!') + rising chime
Perfect streak: ring gets bigger each time, at 8 a short GG.fx.flash
Camera eases up with lerp k = 0.1 [S:eiserloh]
Game over: camera zooms out to show the whole tower
failStates: Block misses the tower completely
genres.winCondition: Reach a target floor (e.g. 25) within the round.

audienceTweaks.kids: Speed cap 0.8 W/s, perfect tolerance 8%, a miss only removes 2 floors.
audienceTweaks.teens: Speed growth +6% per floor, perfect streak counter, best-height line.
audienceTweaks.seniors: Speed fixed at 0.4 W/s, perfect tolerance 8%, target 15 floors.

commonPitfalls: Cut calculation uses sprite x instead of the block's left/right edges, so widths drift [S:factorsim]
Block keeps sliding after game over or tap registers twice (no input lock while dropping) [H]
Speed grows so fast that floor 15 is unplayable [S:cho]

genres.coreLoop: Pull back the sling, aim and release to knock down targets with a limited number of shots.
genres.controls: Drag back from the sling and release. Power grows with drag distance (cap 0.25 H); the shot goes the opposite way.
progression: 3-5 shots per level ('a handful of birds', chosen before building the structure) [S:angrybirds]
3-6 targets per level in simple box structures (Arcade physics: no rotation stacking; boxes fall and get knocked aside) [S:phaser][H]
Projectile gravity 1.6 H/s^2 [H]
Trajectory dots for the first 40% of the path while aiming; the last shot's path stays faintly visible [S:angrybirds][H]
Stars: 1 = all targets down, 2 = with 1 shot left, 3 = with 2 left; thresholds tuned by playtests (Rovio spent more time on ratings than on building) [S:angrybirds]
In a 120 s round: 3 small levels of growing distance and cover [H]
powerUps: Split shot: projectile splits into 3 on tap in mid-air [S:angrybirds]
Heavy shot: pushes boxes twice as far [H]
juice: Sling band stretches with the drag and snaps back with an elastic tween
Launch: GG.sfx('jump') + projectile squashes then stretches along velocity [S:juicy-breakout]
Impact: GG.fx.hit on the target + GG.fx.shake by impact speed (light/medium)
Boxes flash white on hit and wobble
Score popups float from each fallen target
Level clear: stars appear one by one with GG.fx.pop + GG.sfx('coin')
failStates: Shots run out with targets still standing
genres.winCondition: Knock down all targets in each level before shots run out.

audienceTweaks.kids: Long trajectory preview (80%), targets close and big, unlimited shots with stars for fewer.
audienceTweaks.teens: Shorter preview (20%), moving targets in level 3.
audienceTweaks.seniors: Drag anywhere (not only from the sling), long preview, 6 shots, no time pressure.

commonPitfalls: Expecting realistic tower collapse from Arcade physics; it only has rectangles/circles with no rotation physics [S:phaser]
Projectile never stops, so the turn never ends; end the shot after 4 s or when speed < threshold [S:opengame]
Release outside the canvas never fires pointerup; also handle pointerupoutside [S:phaser]
Targets placed out of reach of the max-power arc [H]

genres.coreLoop: Enemies walk along a fixed path; tap empty slots to build towers that shoot them before they reach the base.
genres.controls: Tap an empty slot to build (if enough coins); tap a tower to upgrade it. No drag.
progression: Waves grow like Plants vs. Zombies 1-1: 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, then a flagged huge wave of 9 [S:pvz]
For a 150 s round: 6 waves of 3, 4, 5, 6, 8 and a final big wave of 12, 8 s between waves [H]
Enemy speed +2% per wave (Bloons late game uses +0.02 per round) [S:bloons]
Enemy HP x1.15 per wave [H]
Start coins for exactly 2 towers; each kill gives coins so a third tower is affordable by wave 2 [H]
One new mechanic at a time: 2nd tower type unlocks at wave 3 (PvZ spreads mechanics out) [S:pvz]
objectKinds: fast runner (x1.6 speed, half HP) from wave 3
tank (x4 HP) in the final wave
powerUps: Freeze all enemies: 4 s, one per round [H]
Coin rain: +50 coins, from a rare enemy drop [H]
juice: Tower built: GG.fx.pop + dust burst + GG.sfx('pop')
Towers rotate to face their target; recoil 3 px on each shot [S:nijman]
Enemy hit: white flash; kill: GG.fx.burst + coin flies to the coin counter
Coin counter pulses when it increases
Huge wave warning: GG.fx.banner('Большая волна!') 3 s before it starts [S:pvz]
Enemy reaching base: GG.fx.shake('medium') + base hearts shake
failStates: Base lives (10) reach zero

audienceTweaks.kids: 4 waves only, enemies are cute and 'run away' instead of dying, towers are free.
audienceTweaks.teens: Faster waves (5 s gaps), tower upgrades, bonus for no leaks.
audienceTweaks.seniors: Wave starts only when the player taps 'Дальше', slower enemies (x0.6), slots large.

commonPitfalls: Path and slots overlap, or slots are smaller than the tap target [H]
Towers target dead or recycled enemies (stale references after pooling) [S:phaser]
Economy broken: cannot afford a single tower, or money so plentiful no choice matters [H]
Final wave never spawns because the wave counter is off by one, so the game never ends [S:opengame]

genres.coreLoop: Steer the snake on a grid to eat food; it grows with every bite; don't hit yourself.
genres.controls: Swipe in a direction to turn. Alternative: on-screen 4-arrow pad at the bottom with buttons at least the profile's tap target.
progression: Grid about 12 columns x 18 rows in portrait (Google Snake standard map 15x17) [S:snake][H]
Move tick 0.18 s at start, -0.005 s per food, floor 0.09 s (Nokia levels differ only by the wait between moves) [S:snake][H]
+1 segment per food (the +1 rule is a convention; not verified in a primary source) [H]
Bonus food every 5th piece, disappears after 5 s [H]
Obstacle blocks appear after 10 food, never on the snake's next 3 cells [S:spelunky][H]
powerUps: Slow-mo: tick x1.5 longer for 6 s [H]
Ghost: pass through own body for 5 s [H]
juice: Eat: head squashes, GG.fx.burst at food, GG.sfx('coin') with pitch rising per food
A bulge travels from head to tail after each meal
Food pops in with GG.fx.pop and pulses gently
Body segments smoothly interpolate between cells instead of jumping
Death: segments scatter outward one by one, GG.fx.shake('medium')
Length milestone (every 10): GG.fx.banner
failStates: Head hits own body
head hits a wall (if walls are on)
genres.winCondition: Reach a target length (e.g. 20) within the round.

audienceTweaks.kids: Borderless (wraps around), tick 0.25 s fixed, self-collision only shrinks the tail.
audienceTweaks.teens: Walls on, faster floor 0.07 s, bonus food chase.
audienceTweaks.seniors: Wraps around, tick 0.3 s fixed, arrow buttons instead of swipes, target length 12.

commonPitfalls: Two quick swipes in one tick reverse the snake into itself; queue turns (max 2) and reject 180-degree turns [H]
Food spawns on the snake's body [H]
Movement tied to frames instead of a fixed tick, so speed depends on the device [S:phaser]
Instant death when touching a wall the same tick as turning; give one tick of grace (Nokia Snake allowed a few ms before a crash) [S:snake]

genres.coreLoop: Swap two adjacent tiles to line up 3 or more of a colour; matches clear, tiles fall and cascade.
genres.controls: Swipe a tile toward a neighbour, or tap one tile then a neighbour.
progression: Columns = floor(0.96 W / min tap target), clamped to 5..8; Bejeweled uses 8x8, Candy Crush at most 9x9 [S:bejeweled][S:king-patent]
Colours: 5 by default; 6 for teens; 4 for kids/seniors. One colour more or less can flip a level from nearly impossible to medium (King) [S:king-gdc]
Timed round 60 s like Bejeweled Blitz, or a move limit of 20-25 moves [S:bejeweled][H]
Score: 3-match 30, 4-match 60, 5-match 100, cascade multiplier x1, x2, x3... [H]
Speed bonus: 3 matches within 3 s gives a bonus, as in Blitz [S:bejeweled]
Difficulty levers if you need them: objectives, moves, star thresholds, number of colours, blockers (King GDC 2016) [S:king-gdc]
objectKinds: line blaster: 4 in a line, clears a row or column [S:king-patent]
bomb: L or T of 5, clears a 3x3 area [S:king-patent][S:bejeweled]
colour bomb: 5 in a line, swap to clear every tile of that colour [S:king-patent]
powerUps: +5 seconds tile in timed mode (Candy Crush timed levels) [S:king-patent]
Shuffle button: one free reshuffle [S:bejeweled]
Last Hurrah: when time is up, all special tiles on the board fire for bonus points [S:bejeweled]
juice: Swap tween 150 ms; an invalid swap swings back with a small shake of both tiles
Matched tiles grow to 1.2 then pop with GG.fx.burst in their colour
Falling tiles land with GG.fx.squash, staggered by 30 ms per column
Cascade: each step raises the pitch and shows 'x2', 'x3' floats
Special tile creation: white flash on the tile + GG.sfx('powerup')
Colour bomb: beams from the bomb to every tile of that colour, then GG.fx.shake('medium')
Hint: after 5 s idle the hint tiles wiggle (King: hint after a few seconds) [S:king-patent][H]
failStates: Timer or moves run out below the target score
genres.winCondition: Reach the target score (or clear N tiles of a colour) before time or moves run out.

audienceTweaks.kids: 4 colours, 5 columns, no timer (moves only), every match plays a cheerful sound.
audienceTweaks.teens: 6 colours, Blitz-style 60 s with speed bonus and multipliers.
audienceTweaks.seniors: 4 colours, 5 columns with visible gaps, tap-tap swap, no timer, hint after 4 s.

commonPitfalls: Starting board already contains matches, or there is no valid move; after every cascade check for a move and reshuffle without creating matches (King patent) [S:king-patent]
Silent rule bugs: L/T shapes counted twice, cascades not re-checked, specials not triggering; puzzle games had the lowest intent alignment in the OpenGame benchmark [S:opengame]
Input accepted during falling animations, so two swaps overlap and the grid desyncs; lock input until the board settles [H]
Cells smaller than the profile's tap target because an 8x8 board was hard-coded [S:king-patent]

genres.coreLoop: Flip two cards at a time to find matching pairs; remember where each picture was.
genres.controls: Tap a card to flip it. Input is locked while a mismatched pair is shown.
progression: Pairs: 6 (3x4) for kids and seniors, 8 (4x4) for adults, 10 (4x5) for teens [S:cowan][H]
Working memory holds about 4 chunks in adults (Cowan); children's visual capacity doubles between 5 and 10; older adults are weaker at binding item to location [S:cowan][S:riggs][S:cowan2006]
Mismatched pair stays visible 1.0 s before flipping back [H]
Optional preview: all cards visible for 2 s at the start [H]
Multi-level round: 3 boards of growing size (e.g. 4, 6, 8 pairs) in 120 s [H]
objectKinds: bonus card: reveals all cards for 1.5 s
powerUps: Peek: all cards flip open for 1.5 s, once per board [H]
Extra time: +10 s [H]
juice: Flip: scaleX tween 1 to 0 to 1 over 200 ms, swapping the face at 0 + GG.sfx('tap')
Match: both cards jump (GG.fx.pop) and spark (GG.fx.burst) + GG.sfx('coin')
Mismatch: both cards shake horizontally 6 px for 200 ms + soft low tone
Streak of matches: 'x2' float and brighter sparkles
Board cleared: cards spin away one by one, GG.fx.banner
Cards deal in from the deck with a 40 ms stagger at the start
failStates: Timer ends
mistake limit reached (optional)
genres.winCondition: Find all pairs within the round (or all boards).

audienceTweaks.kids: 6 pairs, big friendly pictures, no timer, 2 s preview.
audienceTweaks.teens: 10 pairs, timer and 'perfect memory' bonus for no mistakes.
audienceTweaks.seniors: 6 pairs, high-contrast distinct pictures (not similar shades), no timer, mismatch visible 1.5 s.

commonPitfalls: Odd number of cards or a picture used 3 times, so the board can never be cleared [S:opengame]
Tapping the same card twice counts as a match [H]
Third card can be flipped while two are open (no input lock) [H]
Pictures that differ only by colour, unreadable for colour-blind players (Apple HIG: don't rely on colour alone) [H]

genres.coreLoop: Answer a short series of questions against a per-question timer; faster correct answers score more.
genres.controls: Tap one of 3-4 big answer buttons.
progression: 7-12 questions per round (QuizUp 7, HQ Trivia 12) [S:quizup][S:hq]
10 s per question (QuizUp, HQ Trivia); 20 s for seniors and kids [S:quizup][S:hq][H]
Points = round(1000 x (1 - (answerTime / timer) / 2)), so a correct answer scores 500-1000 (Kahoot formula) [S:kahoot]
Last question worth double (QuizUp) [S:quizup]
Questions ordered easy to hard (HQ, Millionaire) [S:hq][S:millionaire]
powerUps: 50/50: removes two wrong answers, once per round (Millionaire) [S:millionaire]
Extra life: one wrong answer forgiven (HQ Trivia extra lives) [S:hq]
Freeze timer for one question [H]
juice: Question slides in with Back.Out; answers drop in staggered by 60 ms
Timer bar shrinks and turns from green to red in the last 3 s, with a soft tick
Correct: button turns green, GG.fx.burst + GG.sfx('coin') + score counts up
Wrong: button shakes, turns red, the correct one pulses green for 1 s
Streak of 3: GG.fx.banner('Серия x3!')
Final screen: correct answers revealed one by one
failStates: Too many wrong answers (e.g. 3)
round ends below the pass score
genres.winCondition: Answer at least N of M correctly (e.g. 7 of 10).

audienceTweaks.kids: Picture questions with 2-3 options, 20 s or no timer, no penalty for wrong answers.
audienceTweaks.teens: 10 s timer, speed scoring, streak bonus.
audienceTweaks.seniors: 20 s or no timer (WCAG 2.2.1: time limits adjustable), 3 options, big buttons stacked vertically, plain wording.

commonPitfalls: Wrong or ambiguous facts generated by the model; keep questions to widely known facts and double-check the answer key in code [H]
Correct answer always in the same position; shuffle answers per question [H]
Long questions overflow buttons at the audience's font size; wrap text and limit to about 90 characters [H]
Timer keeps running during the feedback animation or after the last question [S:opengame]
references: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?

genres.coreLoop: Tap the big object to earn coins, buy upgrades that earn automatically, watch the numbers grow toward a goal.
genres.controls: Tap the main object; tap upgrade buttons in a panel at the bottom.
progression: Upgrade cost = base x 1.15^owned (Cookie Clicker); AdVenture Capitalist uses 1.07-1.15 [S:cookie][S:adcap]
Production grows linearly with count; x2 milestones at 25 and 50 owned (AdVenture Capitalist) [S:pecorella][S:adcap]

For a 60-120 s round, compress: first upgrade affordable after about 5 s of tapping, then a new purchase every 8-15 s (Cookie Clicker's first purchase comes after 5-10 s; low-confidence observation) [S:cookie-onboarding][H]
4-5 upgrade tiers, each about 8-10x the cost of the previous (Cookie Clicker 15, 100, 1100, 12000) [S:cookie]
Goal scaled so a player who buys sensibly reaches it at about 80% of the round [H]
objectKinds: golden bonus that drifts across (tap within 3 s)
powerUps: Golden bonus: x7 production for 10 s (Cookie Clicker 'Frenzy' style) [H]
Tap frenzy: each tap worth x5 for 5 s [H]
juice: Each tap: main object squashes (GG.fx.squash) and a '+N' float rises from the tap point
Coins arc from the object into the coin counter
Counter rolls up smoothly rather than jumping; large numbers formatted 1.2K, 3.4M
Affordable upgrade buttons glow and bob; buying one: GG.fx.pop + GG.sfx('powerup')
Each new tier adds a visible worker or building to the scene (permanence) [S:nijman]
Milestone x2: GG.fx.banner + coin burst
failStates: Round timer ends before the goal
genres.winCondition: Reach the coin goal (e.g. 1,000,000) before the timer ends.

audienceTweaks.kids: Only 3 tiers, big pictures instead of numbers, goal shown as a filling jar.
audienceTweaks.teens: More tiers, golden bonus chase, 'per second' display.
audienceTweaks.seniors: 3 tiers, large buttons with price and effect in words, no drifting golden bonus (or it stays 6 s).

commonPitfalls: Numbers overflow the screen (no K/M formatting) or exceed Number precision [H]
Goal unreachable in the round with any strategy; simulate the economy before choosing the goal [H]
Tapping becomes pointless after the first auto-producer; keep taps worth at least 20% of income [H]
Nothing changes on screen except numbers (static screen) [S:opengame]

genres.coreLoop: Objects are tossed up from below; swipe through them to slice, but never slice a bomb.
genres.controls: Swipe (drag) across objects; every segment of the finger path cuts. No taps needed.
progression: Arcade-style 60 s round (Zen mode is 90 s with no bombs) [S:fruitninja]
Tosses come in waves tuned for combos: 1-2 objects early, 3-6 later, interval 1.4 s / d(t) [S:fruitninja][S:cho][H]
Bombs about 1 in 6 objects, none in the first 8 s [S:fruitninja][H]
Objects rise to 55-75% of screen height and fall under gravity of about 1.4 H/s^2 [H]
Classic mode alternative: 3 dropped objects end the game, +1 life every 100 points [S:fruitninja]
objectKinds: fruit: +1, hit area larger than the sprite [S:fruitninja]
bomb: -10 points and combo reset in timed mode, hit area smaller than the sprite [S:fruitninja]
special fruit: several slices for extra points [H]
powerUps: Frenzy: fruit tossed from the sides nonstop, about 7 s [S:fruitninja]
Freeze: slow motion and the timer pauses, about 7 s [S:fruitninja]
Double points: about 7 s [S:fruitninja]
juice: Blade trail follows the finger: 10-15 fading segments, width tapering [S:juicy-breakout][H]
Sliced fruit splits into two halves along the swipe angle, halves fly apart and spin
Juice splat stays on the background for 3 s (permanence) [S:nijman]
Combo of 3+ in one swipe: big 'Комбо x4!' float + bonus points
Bomb sliced: 200 ms white flash, GG.fx.shake('heavy'), everything pauses briefly
Each slice: short GG.sfx('pop') with random pitch, GG.vibrate(10) for adults/teens
failStates: Timer ends below the target score
in classic mode: 3 objects dropped or a bomb sliced
genres.winCondition: Reach the target score in 60 s.

audienceTweaks.kids: Zen-style: no bombs, slower toss (gravity x0.7), big fruit.
audienceTweaks.teens: Bombs from second 5, combos and Frenzy more often.
audienceTweaks.seniors: No bombs or very distinct bombs, toss gravity x0.6 so objects hang longer, 90 s round, a short tap also slices.

commonPitfalls: Only the current pointer position is tested, so fast swipes skip objects; test the line segment between the last two pointer positions [H]
A finger resting on the screen keeps slicing; require movement speed above a threshold [H]
Objects tossed off-screen sideways or too high, so they can't be reached [H]
Bomb hit area as big as fruit makes the game feel unfair (Halfbrick made bombs smaller) [S:fruitninja]
references: Cut the Rope (ZeptoLab, 2010) for swipe-to-cut input
